items.en: Shandong Linglong Tyre Co., Ltd. has informed its shareholders that it expects a significant decline in year-on-year net profit during the first three quarters of 2026. The tyre maker forecasts a decrease of 94.09 to 94.69 per cent, citing foreign exchange losses, higher raw material and shipping costs, pressure on overseas selling prices and weaker domestic original equipment demand.

A parliamentary inquiry into Australia’s tyre industry has proposed reforms ranging from mandatory producer stewardship and retreading support to tighter waste export controls and greater use of recycled tyre materials – measures with relevance for manufacturers and suppliers serving the market and for other countries reviewing end-of-life tyre policy. The House Standing Committee on Industry, Innovation and Science tabled its report, When the rubber hits the road: inquiry into the Australian tyre industry, on 15 October 2026. It makes 12 recommendations aimed at strengthening the country’s tyre circular economy.
